free_tier.stated: Object store with 5 GB max per object, but the Free plan is 300 credits/month where 1 GB of web bandwidth = 20 credits — i.e. ~15 GB of transfer/month total, shared with every other metered feature.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Metered in credits: 'Web Bandwidth | 1 GB transferred | 20 credits'. Free plan has '300 credits/month with credit hard limit'. ~15 GB/month of egress — three orders of magnitude short.

tooling: Netlify JS/TS SDK (getStore/put/get) callable from Functions or Build Plugins; no S3/WebDAV/SFTP and no rclone backend. Access requires a Netlify site + function invocation.
chaining: 500 projects per team x 300 credits, but credits are per team, not per project, so 500 sites do not multiply the allowance. Unlimited free teams would multiply, at ~15 GB egress each.
limits_note: 5 GB per object, 600-byte object keys, 2 KB metadata; Free = 300 credits/month hard cap covering bandwidth, requests (10,000 req = 2 credits) and functions compute; Go functions cannot access Blobs.
